newsitem.title: USA: U.S stocks surge after steady Fed, as techs sizzle.
newsitem.headline: U.S stocks surge after steady Fed, as techs sizzle.

text.p: U.S. stocks surged in a late rally Tuesday, with Wall Street reassured by the Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates unchanged.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up 113 to 7916 unofficially. Combined with Monday's gains of nearly 109 points, the advance erased most of Friday's 247-point drop.
"We were able to bounce back with the Fed's non-action, the UPS settlement and there was a lot of money flowing into technology stocks," a trader said.
